{"metadata":{"description":"一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的浮动鲸鱼小宠物（参考 DeepSeek 鲸鱼 logo 与 Codex 的宠物功能），实时展示当前 agent / tool 的执行状态。","id":"gh:1336944655","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"deepseek-haeness-pet","slug":"z15692312501/deepseek-haeness-pet","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的浮动鲸鱼小宠物（参考 DeepSeek 鲸鱼 logo 与 Codex 的宠物功能），实时展示当前 agent / tool 的执行状态。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness Whale Pet"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A floating whale mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — inspired by the DeepSeek whale logo and"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" the Codex "pet" — that shows what the agent is doing right now."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的浮动鲸鱼小宠物（参考 DeepSeek 鲸鱼 logo 与 Codex 的宠物功能），实时展示当前 agent / tool 的执行状态。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*(add a screenshot at `docs/demo.png` to show it in action / 把运行截图放到 `docs/demo.png` 展示效果)*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ⚠️ Read this first / 先看这里"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**This is not a standalone npm package.** It is a plugin written *for the DeepSeek Harness monorepo*"},{"id":"p7s2","text":": it depends on the harness's internal `@deepseek-ai/*` workspace packages and its build pipeline (`"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"tsc` + `tsdown` + the Typert Remote codegen). To use it you copy the two packages into a harness che"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ckout, wire them into the composition, and rebuild — see Integration."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**它不是一个可以 `npm install` 直接用的独立包。** 这是为 DeepSeek Harness monorepo 写的插件：依赖 harness 内部的 `@deepseek-ai/*"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"` workspace 包与构建管线（`tsc` + `tsdown` + Typert Remote 代码生成）。使用方式是把它拷进 harness 仓库、接入 composition 并重新构建，"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e 包与构建管线（`tsc` + `tsdown` + Typert Remote 代码生成）。使用方式是把它拷进 harness 仓库、接入 composition 并重新构建，见下文「集成步骤」。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does / 功能"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"A small blue whale floats in the corner of the GUI and reflects the agent loop:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| State | Behaviour | 状态说明 |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **idle** | slow breathing, bubble says `空闲中 · 待命中` | 空闲：缓慢浮动 |
| **thinking** | faster bob + blue "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"pulse, `思考中…` | 思考中：加速浮动 + 蓝色脉冲点 |
| **running a tool** | water spout + green pulse, `正在执行 <tool> · "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"<arg>` | 执行工具：喷水动画 + 绿色脉冲点 |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Click the whale to expand a **recent-activity** log; drag it to reposition. It follows the GUI's lig"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ht/dark theme via the `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"点击鲸鱼可展开「最近活动」日志，可拖拽移动位置；配色随 GUI 明暗主题自适应。"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Architecture / 架构"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Two packages, split along the Harness's host/client boundary:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Package | Plane | Role |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-pet` | Host | Listens to `agent/status`, `tools/pre-execute`, `tools/result`, ke"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"eps the live status + activity ring, and exposes a read-only `@Remote('state')` snapshot. |
| `@deep"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"seek-ai/dsh-client-ui-pet` | Client | A `dsh.client` plugin that renders the whale in the `shell.ove"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"rlay` layer and polls `ctx.remote.pet.state()` every ~700 ms. |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| 包 | 平面 | 职责 |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-pet` | Host | 监听 `agent/status`、`tools/pre-execute`、`tools/result`，维护当前状态与活动环形缓冲"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"，通过 `@Remote('state')` 暴露只读快照。 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-pet` | Client | `dsh.client` 插件，在 `sh"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ell.overlay` 浮动层画鲸鱼，约每 700ms 轮询 `ctx.remote.pet.state()`。 |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Repository layout / 目录结构"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Integration / 集成步骤"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Copy the two packages into a DeepSeek Harness checkout, then wire the composition, project reference"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s, path mapping, and the Remote assembly. The full, ordered checklist lives in **docs/INTEGRATION.md"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"** — it was derived by actually getting a build to pass, so follow it exactly."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"把两个包拷进 DeepSeek Harness 仓库，然后依次接入 composition、project references、路径映射、Remote 装配。完整步骤见 **docs/INTEGRA"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"TION.md**——它是实测构建通过后整理出来的，请按步骤来。"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Quick sketch（速览）:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Copy `packages/pet/pet` and `packages/client/ui-pet` into the harness repo.
2. Add the `pet` + `u"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"i-pet` rows to `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`, **and** mirror them in that bundle's `pac"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"kage.json` `dependencies` (missing this is the classic `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`).
3. Register the proj"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ect references, the `dsh-pet` path mappings, and the `remote.pet` assembly (see INTEGRATION.md).
4. "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"`pnpm install` → `pnpm run build` → restart `dsh web` → refresh."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Compatibility / 兼容性"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Built and verified against the DeepSeek Harness revision it was developed on. Because the integratio"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"n touches the harness's explicit reference/manifest lists, the exact line positions may drift across"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" harness versions — treat the steps as a guide and reconcile against the files in your checkout."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"在与开发时同版本的 DeepSeek Harness 上构建并验证通过。因为集成要改 harness 的显式引用清单，不同版本的行位置可能变化——请以你本地 harness 的文件为准做对齐。"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## License / 授权"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"MIT — same as the DeepSeek Harness itself."}],"truncated":false}
